notes:
Summary: Goldcrest runs an institutional research portal used by analysts and PMs. Primary need is a scalable embeddings + reranking pipeline for RAG search across research notes, filings, and transcripts. Prefers dedicated capacity (predictable throughput) and customer KMS with strict US-only residency.

Key requirements/asks (from AE/SE conversations):
- Index scale: target initial corpus 300M docs (paragraphs) with roadmap to 1B within 12 months.
- Latency: interactive SLAs — 95th percentile end-to-end search + rerank <400ms for single-query flows; batch analytics can be slower.
- Throughput: peak concurrency ~500 qps for hourly quantiles during market open.
- Cost: cost-per-query sensitivity high; procurement wants TCO numbers for dedicated vs managed; goal roughly <$0.005/query at 10k qps-month equivalent (internal target, negotiable).
- Model preferences: open models preferred (13B quantized variants ok) with option to fall back to smaller cross-encoder reranker for hot-path.
- Security/compliance: must support customer-managed KMS, SSO/SAML, audit logs, retention controls, and documented data residency (US-only).
- Routing/fallbacks: want deterministic routing policy to avoid cross-region data movement; fallback to smaller model in same region if capacity constrained.

Recent touches / timeline: see timeline field for detail. SE ran small embedding quality tests with 100k paragraphs (notes: recall ok, need reranker to remove noise). We discussed automatic prefix caching to reduce cost.

Quotes/voice notes: "We need firm numbers for dedicated TCO vs hosted before legal moves to procurement." — Head of Data Platforms.

Stubs/attachments: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive. Fireflies have transcripts for both product and security calls. Jira tickets opened for KMS connector examples.

Sales posture: PLG -> AE assisted. High likelihood to convert if POC proves dedicated latency & cost targets and KMS/residency language acceptable.
